exposure: perineal tear after previous vaginal delivery
cohort: 500 women in the Hail Region of Saudi Arabia
finding: Cesarean delivery rates were not significantly associated with maternal age or parity, but were significantly associated with BMI, perineal tear after previous vaginal delivery, and history of diabetes mellitus and gestational diabetes.
mod_finding: The number of cesarean deliveries was not associated with parity or maternal age.
